title: Parse syslog lines
hints: Build the pattern left to right with a named group per field: (?P<timestamp>...) (?P<host>\S+) (?P<process>...) and so on. Test it in the REPL on the example lines as you go.
The timestamp is [A-Z][a-z]{2} [ \d]\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d; the padded day is why the day group is [ \d]\d.
Make the pid optional as a whole: (?:\[(?P<pid>\d+)\])?. The process class must not include '[' or ':' or it will swallow them: [\w.-]+.
m.groupdict() gives the dict; then set parsed['pid'] = int(...) if m.group('pid') else None. parse_syslog is a loop that keeps non-None results.
